tenures.bio:
Team: Boogiepop Dynasty







Name:



-Rampage (Ryo Tazawa)



-Cellacia (Reimi Otonachi)



-Kyoshiro (Kyoshiro Kimura)



Birth Dates:



-August 4, 1977 (25)



-May 18, 1981 (21)



-March 23, 1979 (23)



Hometowns:



-Nara, Honshu, Japan



-Kumamoto, Kyuushuu, Japan



-Kochi, Shikoku, Japan



Heights:



-6’2



-5’8



-5’11



Weights:



-284 lbs



-173 lbs



-249 lbs



Nicknames:



-Rampage: ‘Page, Rock Star



-Cellacia: Cell, Boogiepop, J-Pop Princess



-Kyoshiro: Kyo, #1 Slugga



Status: Face

Entrance Music: “Kagami Kamen” (Mirror Mask) by Boogiepop Dynasty (BD’s first single)



Wrestling Styles: 



-Rampage: Technical/Shoot Style wrestling, focusing on suplex and submission chains, working on specific body parts to set up for the kill.



-Cell: High Flying/Gymnastics, lucha libre-like movement through the ring, flipping and spinning acrobatic maneuvers that will land the opponent on the mat. 



-Kyo: Brawling/Martial Arts, a fighter to the end, working on punches and kicks to down his opponent as they do in the streets, hence the name, #1 Slugga



Set Up Move: 



Complete B-Dynasty setup: Fusion Beats: Cell performs a spinning legscissors arm drag (Sickle Cell), followed by Kyo nailing a double axe handle uppercut the opponent into the corner (#1 Slugga). Rampage comes in w/ a splash, but grabs the opponent and throws him over with an overhead belly to belly suplex (1/3 of Retroplex).



Cell/Kyo setup: Hip/Pop: Cell pushes opponent into the ropes and leaps up, grabbing them in a jumping hip toss. The throw sends the opponent over sitting up on the mat, but just as impact is made Kyo comes in with a sliding Karate kick to the face, knocking them down on their face.



Cell/Rampage setup: Heavy Metal Queen: Rampage lifts the opponent up for a Brainbuster, and Cell runs in, leaps up and wraps her legs around the opponent’s upper torso. The weight sends all three down, Rampage in a Brainbuster DDT and Cell in a sitting bearhug piledriver.



Rampage/Kyo setup: The Beatdown: Rampage locks in a full nelson from behind, allowing Kyo to come in with a right cross to the jaw, left hook shot to the midsection, and a final right uppercut to the chin as Rampage goes over w/ the Dragon Suplex.



Cell: Sickle Cell: A spinning legscissors arm drag; Cell runs on the opponent and goes for a spinning legscissors, but spins completely around and morphs the move into a spinning arm drag, sending the opponent into the mat and dizzying them as they rise back up.



Kyo: #1 Slugga: An uppercutting double axe handle smash that knocks the opponent back, mostly aimed so that the opponent falls back into the corner or ropes. 



Rampage: Retroplex: Rampage locks his arms around the opponent and throws them over w/ an overhead belly to belly suplex, but rolls over, squats over the opponent w/ his arms still locked, and pulls the opponent up with another overhead belly to belly. Pulling the opponent back up once more, Rampage turns 180 degrees and nails a releasing belly to belly suplex. 



Finishers:



Complete B-Dynasty finisher: Boogiepop Revolution: Kyo runs in with Da Noise, knocking the opponent back into the waiting arms of Rampage for the Acoustic. Cell comes off with the finishing, jumping up and pinning both of the opponent’s legs to the ground with her own legs and bridges as Rampage bridges the Acoustic.



Rampage: Acoustic: Rampage grabs the opponent in a tiger suplex from behind, locking his hands around the arms in a vertical over horizontal position. Then he locks his hips and snaps the opponent over, slamming them straight onto the back of their head/back. (snap tiger suplex)



Kyo: Da Noise: Kyo runs in with a spinning elbow smash (roaring elbow) into the temple of the opponent, knocking them back onto the mat out cold. 



Cell: Idol Hands: Cell locks hands with the opponent and leaps up for a hurricanrana. Cell then rolls over so that she is back to back with her opponent, hands still locked. Then she pulls herself back and locks her legs around the person’s neck, flipping them over for a reverse rana into an sitout mat slam/x-factor.



Cell/Kyo finisher: Gentle Verse: Cell performs the Idol Hands, but just as she goes to complete the final portion, Kyo runs in and delivers Da Noise, adding extra impact to the reverse rana/x-factor from Cell.



Cell/Rampage finisher: Uncut Version: Rampage goes for the Acoustic, and just as he snaps the opponent over Cell flips over with a somersault axe kick into the throat of the opponent, a double impact on the neck from both sides. 



Rampage/Kyo finisher: Amp Frequency: Rampage prepares for the Acoustic, and Kyo adds in extra power to the move with  #1 Slugga right under the chin before Rampage completes his move.



Kyo Move set-



Kimura Slide: Kyo slides in through the legs of the opponent, grabbing the ankles and pulling them down face first into the mat. 



7th Inning: Moving in with a back elbow thrust into the midsection, Kyo grabs the back of the head and holds it as he comes up with a knee into the face of the opponent. Then he closes it with a side shuffle kick into the face, knocking them back into the mat. 



Street Pitcher: Kyo throws the opponent into the ropes, and when they come back he nails them under the chin with a thrust kick. The opponent falls back into the ropes, and Kyo catches them on the rebound, grabbing them by the neck and throws them down with a judo hip toss on the mat.



Bases Loaded: A spear into a mounted punch set, Kyo tackling the opponent before kneeling over them and pummeling them with both fists. 



Fastball: Known in the streets for his quick hands, Kyo comes around with a quick roundhouse hook across the face of the victim. Usually used around the end of a punching comeback, or as a sudden counter against strikes. 



Cell Move set-



White Cell: Jump Swinging Hurricanrana; Cell runs at the opponent, and jumps up, swinging around the person like a jump swinging DDT, but when she comes around to the front of the opponent, she leaps up and nails them with a swift hurricanrana. 



Red Cell: Cell leaps up, grabbing the person’s head and leaning back into a DDT, but Cell adds more impact as she monkey flips the opponent over, putting more force into the DDT



J-Pop: A counter as well as an attack; Cell grabs the opponent and whips them away, but holds onto them. She yanks them back and presses her back against the person’s chest, snatching the opponent over in a modified judo hip toss/rotating fireman’s carry. A counter if whipped and she reverses.



Idol Image: Cell leaps up for a hurricanrana, but spins around so that she faces the same way as the victim. Then she hangs down, her ankles around the opponent’s head as she reaches under and grabs the opponent’s legs, pulling the opponent’s head down into the mat as they drop down to their knees. A pin attempt can be made if she rolls over as she has the legs hooked.



Cellibate: A 360 rotating high angle bulldog. Cell grabs the opponent for a bulldog and runs up the turnbuckle or ropes, springing off in a back flip and drives the opponent back down in a high angle bulldog, Cell landing straight on her back w/ her legs up in the air. Can be used as a counter to a back drop or variation of a back drop.



Rampage Move set-



Emo Flux: Rampage tackles the opponent in the back, knocking them forward into either the mat, the ropes, or the corner. Then he wraps his arms around their waist and nails a snapping overhead German Suplex, Rampage arches over and presses them facedown into the mat to add impact. Optional methods include rolling over and continuing the snapping overhead German suplex chain, bridging for a pin, or rolling over and nailing a releasing suplex.



Heavy Metal: The opponent is snatched up onto Rampage’s shoulders in a fireman’s carry. Then Rampage completely drops backwards, crashing down in a bridging Samoan Drop. Optional methods bridging for a pin, rolling over and nailing another Samoan Drop suplex in chain, or rolling over and nailing a front flipping Samoan Drop suplex. 



Guitar Vader: With the opponent face down on the mat, Rampage locks the arm in a leg scissors armbar, while grabbing the other arm and locking in a half chickenwing. Then he takes his free right arm and leans over, pulling back on the neck of the opponent. (Crossface Chickenwing Armbar Submission.)



Screech and Thrash: Rampage locks in a sharpshooter, and leans back, lodging his knee into the back of the victim and wrenching on the back in a elevated Boston Crab variation. 



Alternative Hype: Locking in a reverse full nelson hold, Rampage throws the opponent over in a reverse Dragon Suplex. Can be chained into multiple suplexes and can be bridged. 













History—



Cellacia Otonachi, Rampage, and Kyoshiro…



The sweet and down to earth brown and white haired girl next door…



The big-hearted and skilled blonde muscle-bound jock…



The rough, cocky, and raspy boy from the streets w/ half a foot tall hairdo…



You probably know these three as friends of the infamous Inphino Blitz, martial artist known throughout the world. But now the group known formerly as the Blitz Promotional Team is taking their chance to make themselves known in two very different ways. 



These three, veterans of puro from the Tokyo Wrestling League, have taken the opportunity to show their wares in the newly reopening PURE, using their past accolades along with their ties to Inphino Blitz and PURE player Mina de Margo to ensure themselves a position within the company…more importantly, to help establish the unique Trinity Division and make it a success.



Their second chance at stardom is in the form of their music. Each of these three members brings a personal touch of musical genius to the group…Cell the J-Pop Princess, Rampage the Rock Star, and Kyo the Verse Villain and the “#1 Slugga” as he is known on the streets. Rap, Pop, and Rock…merged into one entity that they have dubbed:



“Boogiepop Dynasty”



After auditioning for Naoki Records out of Kamakura, the CEOs of the company, the sibling duo of Debutante and Dilettante Masaki, signed these three right away. It wasn’t soon that the same song they auditioned with was released as the group’s first single; Kagami Kamen, or Mirror Mask. The song’s topped charts through the country, and has made good reviews on the foreign markets. Naoki Records has high hopes that their wrestling career will also bring more publicity to the group, as well as increase CD and merchandising sales.



Of course to Cell, Rampage, and Kyo, it’s all about the fans…it’s all about the fight…it’s all about the music. 



You are now under the will of the Boogiepop Dynasty…



-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

tenures.bio:
Born in the same neighbourhood, their mothers were and still are 

good friends. at first Ric and Johnny could not stand the sight of each 

other. With both of the two trying to out do each other wether it be with 

the females or in sport. 



This carried on untill Ric's very first day of high school. Johnny was 

already at High school as he was two years older then Ric. Ric at the time 

was a very shy individual, and did not associate well with the other kids. 

Two of the schools bullies took note of Rics coyness and decided to take 

advantage of it. Upon seeing this Johnny went flipmode and completely 

kicked the two bullies asses. After Ric asked why Johnny did what he did, but 

Johnny has not mentioned why till this very day. 



The two of them stuck together like glue from that day onwards. Johnny 

always had Ric's back and vice verser. They realised that they could not 

live up to their fathers standard (who were successful businessmen). So they 

decided to join a local gym and become established athletes but in what 

sport? Johnny had the braun and an animal like mentality. While on the 

other hand Ric was a swift and cunning little S.O.B! One day they was 

working out, when Ric noticed a poster on the wall: Who's tougher then you. 

No one well come and find out! and thats how Nu Era broke into the 

wrestling business. They won various state wrestling tag team tournaments. 

But said they were bored of the indy circuit and wanted a piece of the big 

time, OSW. So they find them selves signing the dotted line of the most 

extreme tag team tournament. Hoping to get have the chance of a lifetime 

and climb the mountain of success required to become legends and a force to be reckoned with!



After being eliminated from the OSW MET they were accepted into a well established fed known as NTICW the was there for about a month and had a record of 1-0-1, and were named #1 cntender for the tag titles, but NTICW close down and Nu Era were shipped on the first plane to Japan to compete in the well respected fed known as PURE.



Since the introduction of the trinity division to PURE, Ric and Johnny decided to call upon the services of Josh, Johnny's younger brother to help them attain fame in the hallowed halls of PURE

tenures.bio:
Chad Matthews

-------------

“Chad Matthews…”

“Who is Chad Matthews?” I hear you cry… as you look through these documents and begin to wonder. Well, Chad Matthews… for the time being anyway, is a nobody… plain and simple, he is a nobody… but, regardless of that wonderful little tidbit of information, I think that you all deserve to discover how this individual came to be the man that he IS today…



Our story begins on Friday 18th August 1981…



Yes, to those of you who have been able to look at the above details… that day just happens to be the ‘Birthdate’ of our little wannabe here…



Anyway, the story starts on the day that Chad Matthews was brought into this world. His mother and father looked upon him and hoped that he’d be the best of their three sons… despite the advantage that they already had upon him, both Mr and Mrs Matthews were convinced that their son would be following the rest to higher plateaus before anyone would even come to recognize it.



How ironic would that statement be later in his life…



Chad progressed through his earlier years of life like any other kid would… well, any other kid that was able to enjoy the company of two older brothers. To introduce the ‘Brothers Grimm’, Joseph and Max were twins… Max being the older of the two, by all of an hour. Our ‘heroic’ figure of Chad tended to live in peace with his older siblings, although there would be times where altercations were inevitable…



The Great Food Fight of Max’s 11th Birthday…

The Punch-Up of Christmas 1990…



And more famously…

The Karaoke Brawl of Summer 1997…



The later event will be detailed later on, but for now… we’ll go back to the relationship that existed between both Chad and his brothers.



As it was said, the three siblings managed to live in peace for the majority of the time and like any unit, they would always try something together. The reason for this is still unknown, but like three best friends who would never leave the other behind… for some incidents, they would all give the task a shot, just to keep the balance of ‘Power’ equal.



The first major task that all three brothers attempted to do was that of ‘Professional Wrestling’. Despite there being a three year gap between Chad and his brothers, by the time that they wanted to start working the business, Chad had developed into an eager sixteen year old chick magnet and his brothers had walked the steps to hitting their early twenties.



Throughout the beginning of his training, Chad found it impossible to keep up with the things that were being done by everyone else… his body just didn’t seem to be ready to handle the strain and stress of fighting inside the ring… however, he persevered, using the goal of one day bettering his brothers as the only incentive needed to push his body through such vile actions…



Remember how the parents of Chad had said how their son would rise through the ranks like nothing before him? Oh… he rose through the ranks of the academy alright… getting used to the basic spots and offence a lot quicker than his brothers and fellow classmates. After a year of training, everyone had decided that Matthews was ready to be used in their independent promotion, working the curtain jerkers to see what kind of effect the lad would have on the crowd…



It was supposed to be the greatest night of his life…

It was supposed to be the moment that he had always dreamed of… ever since stepping in that ring…

It was supposed to be… the moment that his family would be proudest of him…



Chad worked the match… he was strong, he looked alright… but a part of him was missing that night… that part of him that was family love. Chad knew his family didn’t make the show that night… he could see the gap that was supposed to contain their bodies in the crowd.



Depressed…

Distraught…

Disturbed…



Chad Matthews blew a spot in the bout… he was all set to take a DDT… but something happened, he lost his footing while trying to think of his family and was subsequently drilled headfirst into the canvas…



After that night, Matthews decided to call what he thought was quits from the business… he just didn’t have the heart to keep wrestling if none of his family were going to be around to share this moment with him…



It was six months after this night that he found a new love… a new passion, a new something that would give him the chance to shine without the worry of his parents… this was something that he didn’t need support of family for… it was something that he’d be able to express himself in… and gain recognition from more than just his forgotten family… but all of the country…



Pop music… an ever-expanding empire, never willing to reject a talent that can bring money for their company… and fame for themselves.



Chad had kept one thing secret from everyone when he was growing up… that secret was the fact that he could actually sing. People that sing in the showers… sing when listening to music with headphones… sing in general, Chad did everything of the kind when he was sure that nobody would be around to listen to him.



March 25th 1999…



This too would mark a significant date for Chad… not only would it establish the moment that “PoP Worldwide” was created, but it would also establish the date that Chad Matthews met a fledging artist like himself… the only major difference being that this man was Japanese… and not your average member of the human community…



“Hallo… my name is Kamui Fukamachi… I’ve heard some girls talking about your… ability to sing… and I was wondering if you would be willing to join me…”



Ok… Ok… so things didn’t happen as something as the ‘text extract’ above, but the basic jest of things happened and Kamui effectively asked for Chad to become his partner in business, touring the country… singing to the fans, trying to make something out of what they’d both considered to be wasted lives…



June 15th 1999…

July 22nd 1999…

September 28th 1999…

December 24th 1999…

January 1st 2000…



The above dates, just a few of the times that Chad and Kamui were asked to perform at various functions and what-not. Sure, these boys hadn’t marketed themselves as super material… proclaiming that they were going to be bigger than the World itself… but that didn’t stop them from proclaiming they were the biggest party act going at the moment!



Most orders just assumed that the Canadian/Japanese combination would have been a lot funnier than talent flowing… but that was something that never seemed to come true at any of their shows. Chad Matthews had made something of himself… but even with all the success of being a Party Act… the part of him that longed for the business that was Professional Wrestling called out to him… it cried out for him to go back…



An omen…

A Sign…

A Dealing of Fate?



Nobody knows… not even Chad would be able to answer the question for you himself… but, what he can do, is look up to the Stars on any night and say the words…



“My path is chosen… I did it alone… no longer will I hold myself on people… for it will be my undoing once more…”



Will he come to realize a combination of Musical and Wrestling success in PURE? You’ll just have to stay tuned to find out...

Kamui Fukamachi

------------

“Kamui Fukamachi…”



Unlike his ‘Friend’… Kamui was nothing like the individual that Chad was… no way, no how… like two different books… they had different stories, they had different chapters… hell, the only thing about them that was the same was their gender… and possibly their love for everything that is PoP…



This story begins in a small town in Japan, the actual name of the location is information that Kamui refuses to release… and continues to pass himself off as coming from America. Regardless, he was born to parents that died while he was at a young age. Did this event do as much as to haunt the young child?



Of course it did…

Of course it did…



Kamui moved into an Orphanage at the age of three, taken in by ‘Police Officers’ that found him roaming the empty halls of the home that used to belong to his mother and father. Fukamachi was labelled as the “Kid with Big Dreams” while he was at the Orphanage… they accused him of being too adventurous… too hopeful… too ‘high’ on a future that many people believed would never change… for him, or themselves.



They say that sometimes, you need ONE best friend… ONE person to help you up when you fall…



At the age of ten, Kamui thought that he’d meet that one person… the one individual that would change the pathway of his life… that one soul who would never be able to desert him, not even in his darkest hour…



After seven years in the Orphanage, Kamui had met Mai Fuma, a young girl who had also lost her parents… one way or another. Both aged ten, they became what was the best of friends… doing everything that they could think of together…



She was his Rod of Power…

He was her Tower of Hope…



They meant so much to one another…

They meant everything…



Infact, Kamui became so infatuated with his friend, that he began to serenade her with songs that were sung by the other people around the complex. His graceful voice gave her something to feel… something to hold onto… while not in the physical sense, she took his ability… and enjoyed every second it was in motion…



However…

Like many things before this… like many stories before this one…

When there are two people… happy… excited… caring about each other to points that were previously unimaginable… heartbreak is bound to strike… and for Kamui, it couldn’t have struck at a more horrid moment in his life…



September 1992…

A month that will be forever etched in the memory of Kamui… a month that will always stand the test of time, no matter how long our ‘hero’ decides to live for…



Why the lack of a date?



Simple… he doesn’t remember what day it happened… well, that, or the fact that he doesn’t want to remember the exact day that it happened. We could go into a lot of detail about the events of that time… but it wouldn’t be anything worthwhile… after all, whats done is done… and you can’t regret it…



Aside from the horror behind this date… it was also a turning point for our fourteen year old hero… yes, he decided to take the one thing that bonded him to Mai… and developed from that day forth. For some reason, Kamui was confident that he could connect with people of the other-realm in one way or another… and he himself, tried to believe that his music was the bond that existed between both him and Mai…



A fact of Fukamachi…

A sugar coated dream…

A non-existant hope?



Whatever it is… it’s the one thing that Kamui has left with regards to Mai… his last ever item, his last connection with her.



The time went by following that… Kamui perfected his singing talents… he also learned how to fight, namely to protect himself whenever that sticky situation would arise. Fukamachi wanted to be sure that nothing like Mai would ever be allowed to happen to him again… he wasn’t going to lose another friend…



March 25th 1999…



This too would mark a significant date for Kamui… not only would it establish the moment that he had made it to the country of Canada, but it would also be the first time that he met his future ‘Best Friend’ Chad Matthews.



“Hallo… my name is Kamui Fukamachi… I’ve heard some girls talking about your… ability to sing… and I was wondering if you would be willing to join me…”



Ok… Ok… so things didn’t happen as something as the ‘text extract’ above, but the basic jest of things happened and Kamui effectively asked for Chad to become his partner in business, touring the country… singing to the fans, trying to make something out of what they’d both considered to be wasted lives…



June 15th 1999…

July 22nd 1999…

September 28th 1999…

December 24th 1999…

January 1st 2000…



The above dates, just a few of the times that Chad and Kamui were asked to perform at various functions and what-not. Sure, these boys hadn’t marketed themselves as super material… proclaiming that they were going to be bigger than the World itself… but that didn’t stop them from proclaiming they were the biggest party act going at the moment!



Most orders just assumed that the Canadian/Japanese combination would have been a lot funnier than talent flowing… but that was something that never seemed to come true at any of their shows. Kamui had made something of his life along with Chad, they’d both managed to conquer the world of Independent PoP… but what about the hidden agenda that had been carried with Chad?



Matthews wanted to wrestle…

Kamui decided that he wanted to just put his skills to use…



Would it happen… would it ever?



PURE is the place they are now… the next step of the story is down to them and them alone…

tenures.bio:
Luis- Luis Cesar Sangre was a small time musician, just trying to lead a good life.  One fateful night, a infamous gang rode into town and started some trouble in the bar Luis was working in.  Being the good hearted man he is, Luis rushed in to stop them.  What occurred next still haunts the man to this day.  The gang brutually mangled Luis's right hand with a sledgehammer and torched his home with his mother still inside.  After years of rehibilitation, Luis is out to gain revenge on the men who caused him so much pain and one man in particular, Juan Miguel, who has risen through the ranks during that time to become leader of the gang.  With the help of the unusual nun, Sister Ash, Luis searches the world for his target.  He wrestles along the way to pay expenses and to give him free passage to many foreign countries.



Ash- The young woman, by the name of Ash, awoke one morning in a monestary in Mexico with her memories gone and her past a mystery.  With nowhere else to turn, Ash stayed with the sisters and was taught how to be a woman of god.  As Ash stayed with in the nunery, she started to notice a difference between her and the other nuns.  She was faster and stronger than everyone there.  Her youth brought a headstrong attitude and she was much more extreme in her methods than the others.  Believing her sisters to not be giving their all to thweir cause, Ash left the nunery and took off into the world to make it a better place.  At a local tavern, she met up with a man, by the name of Luis Sangre.  She heard his tragic story and agreed to accompany him on his quest for moral support.

tenures.bio: (sorry its crappy) Originally from Osaka, Japan, Ryu and Otoshi have been lifelong friends and have always had a passion for Professional wrestler, gaining a small following in Japan, the two decided to go over to America thinking they could make it there,they joined up with PWA a local training acadamy and after they proved themselves they were released from there. Ryu and Otoshi soon became champions of numerous feds mainly with the indy fed NTICW in which they got involved in a cult called the Followers of the hidden star, after the closure of NTICW, the sushi crew (as they were called) joined up with global sensation PCW, but quit after one week deciding wrestling wasn't fun anymore, a couple of months past until PURE owner Jamar came to the sushi crew with an offer to join PURE, seeing this as an oppurtunity to go back to their homeland the sushi crew accepted and went back to Japan, after 2 shows the Sushi crew with the help of their unwanted partner Shaun Styles won the Trinity belts which they still hold on today...
